name: @olai/prose
//exports: Importable one file at a time, as @olai/markdown-ui is: the browser draws its first paint with the tag grammar and the plain-title test, and neither may pull a heavier file in with it.
//sideEffects: No module here does work at import (src/parse.ts builds its processor on the first parse), so a bundle drops every file it does not call — the browser's first paint imports @olai/format, which imports the reading, and must not carry the parser.
//dependencies: The bottom of the layering, below @olai/format: how a text is read — its tags, its slugs, where a file's frontmatter ends, whether a title holds any markup, and the one Markdown parse (remark-parse with remark-gfm, src/parse.ts) with Obsidian's wikilinks and spaced addresses read as micromark constructs (src/obsidian.ts, built from the micromark pieces listed here). Nothing in the workspace, so everything above can read text the same way; no rendering — solid-js, rehype and highlight.js stay in @olai/markdown-ui.
